def execute(data, out_stream):
    index = 0
    max_len = 0
    pairs_count = 0
    in_paren = False
    while index < len(data):
        if data[index] == '(':
            in_paren = True
        elif data[index] == ')':
            in_paren = False
        elif data[index].isalpha():
            index -= 1
        if in_paren:
            index += 1
            while index != len(data) and data[index] != ')' and not data[index].isalpha():
                index += 1
            if index == len(data) or not data[index].isalpha():
                continue
            while index + 1 < len(data) and data[index + 1].isalpha():
                index += 1
            pairs_count += 1
        else:
            index += 1
            while index != len(data) and data[index] != '(' and not data[index].isalpha():
                index += 1
            if index == len(data) or not data[index].isalpha():
                continue
            start = index
            while index + 1 < len(data) and data[index + 1].isalpha():
                index += 1
            max_len = max(max_len, index - start + 1)
    out_stream.write(str(max_len) + " " + str(pairs_count) + "\n")

def main():
    import sys
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # The first line is ignored as per original code
    # The second line is processed
    if len(input_lines) >= 2:
        data_line = input_lines[1]
        execute(list(data_line), sys.stdout)
